segments.name: Investment management

revenueModel.text: Institutional and individual clients pay fees for investment management services provided by Affiliate firms across alternatives and differentiated long-only strategies.
revenueModel.evidence: Our Affiliates' attractive return streams are utilized in client portfolios to address a range of needs for institutional and individual clients globally; certain Affiliates also provide investment management and customized investment counseling and fiduciary services to high net worth individuals, families, and institutional clients.
